implementation: Each owning CanonicalNativeAdapter shares one bounded metadata scheduler across its native media ports. Public standalone StagedRtpMedia retains its own scheduler. Collect for 1ms, at most 64 jobs per finite epoch and 4096 pending jobs; retain no admission reader while queued or awaiting execution.

Group exact-original single-source audio metadata and call the checked synchronous Core batch. Every recipient retains current source/target policy, route/subscription/generation, cancellation, immutable expiry and original 200ms checks. Local/mixed audio, video and data keep their existing paths.

Port workers own both a completion receipt and the finite epoch join, including cancellation and panic. Closed receipts cannot issue detached IO. Preserve packetizer and physical binding state. Retry only admission NotReady with unchanged metadata; submitted transport errors are terminal.
Failed joins report incomplete cleanup; reconciliation can subsequently confirm actual route absence. No permanent sender worker or idle policy reader is installed.
